outcome: Maternal microchimerism (MMc) detection in umbilical cord blood (CB)
Maternal microchimerism (MMc) concentration in umbilical cord blood (CB)
cohort: The study included 36 preeclampsia (PE) pregnancies and 37 control pregnancies, with DNA extracted from umbilical cord blood mononuclear cells following placental delivery and maternal blood.
finding: There was no significant difference in maternal microchimerism (MMc) detection or concentration in umbilical cord blood between preeclampsia and normal pregnancies.
birth_weight: Lower infant birthweights were observed in the PE group, and birthweight was included as a confounder.
gest_age: PE participants delivered at earlier gestational ages.
